preservation_obligations: Preserve every listed browser route, in-app tab panel, module path, launcher mode and worker source until a behavior-level decision records a supported divergence.
Treat app.html/module loading order and named globals as compatibility boundaries; capture override order before modularization.
Preserve IndexedDB/localStorage data names, encrypted-key migration behavior, exports/imports, and identity/Merkle semantics pending data and crypto characterization.
Preserve provider selection, direct/local/proxied request behavior, API-key handling and failure behavior; no provider consolidation before contract tests.
Preserve offline cache scope and update behavior, including API/localhost service-worker bypasses.
Preserve LAN exposure and CORS behavior as observed until an approved security divergence explicitly changes it.
Do not use the smoke aggregate as proof of compatibility; split obsolete release assertions from current behavioral tests while retaining the original suite unchanged.
